Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI’s strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

Simulation is still a hard sell in robotics. Outside a few success stories, like reinforcement learning for locomotion, most teams skip it, and friction is a big part of why: painful to use, painful to debug. We live that pain ourselves: debugging a failing experiment during policy evaluation takes 30 minutes, and there is no way to automatically generate a standalone reproduction script. That blocks adoption, even internally.

Your job is to kill that friction. You build the software engineering backbone of Genesis-World: everything that makes a large, fast-moving simulation codebase reliable, maintainable, frictionless. And it all ships in the open. Every hour of pain you remove, you remove for every roboticist who comes after you.

You join as core maintainer of Genesis-World, with shared stewardship of the whole platform from day one. Our physics team develops the algorithms, but just as importantly, you work to make everything around them excellent: infrastructure, tooling, APIs, architecture.

The problems waiting for you

  • Make testing of a JIT-compiled engine scalable. Running our full suite is already taking hours because the ratio between compile time and runtime can be as bad as x10. Getting rid of this bottleneck is a serious challenge that will require a joint effort from the Genesis-World and the compiler teams.

  • Make any bug reproducible. Dump and reload simulations bit-exactly, across machines, across backends, even when a single timestep of a batched simulation can already max out VRAM. Turn any failing run into a standalone reproduction script, automatically.

  • Make autodiff first-class. Genesis-World is differentiable today, but partially: memory-hungry, slower than it could be, and hard to maintain due to manual operation recording. The project spans the engine and the compiler: you drive the requirements on Quadrants and iterate in a tight loop with the compiler team until the integration is solid.

  • Edit scenes at frozen time. See the scene, move entities and robots around, iterate on layout, all without building the scene or compiling the engine. Authoring today means a full build cycle. Make it instant.

  • Make the simulator extensible. First-class plugins for physics solvers and interactive viewer backends, including Nyx. Sensors already work this way. Generalize it, and Genesis-World becomes a platform others build on.

  • Give robots real actuation. Motors and MIMO transmissions, cleanly abstracted at the interface between users and the physics engine.

  • Make time a local variable. Today the clock and the timestep are global to the engine, which forbids whole classes of speedups: environments cannot step independently, the timestep cannot adapt to the state, and individual solvers cannot advance at their own rate. Free the clock down to the sub-scene level and let the simulation fly.

  • Make scenes come alive. Events triggered by physics: press the button and the microwave door pops open, squeeze the trigger and the drill spins.

  • Keep the core sharp. Refactoring legacy subsystems, stronger typing, consistent coding style, less Python overhead on hot paths, full scene serialization, telemetry and replay.

Beyond the code: you review issues and pull requests with the core team, answer questions from users and contributors, and can join the push on adoption.

Who you are

You care about the engineer using what you build as much as the thing itself. A slow test, a cryptic error, a manual step: you see it, you go after the root cause, and you remove it for everyone. You have opinions about API design.

You are comfortable with physics and robotics: the right design choices take a working picture of what a simulator like Genesis-World does, how it works, and how it is used, a picture you can partly build on the job.

  • Strong Python engineering on large codebases: architecture, refactoring, typing, packaging, performance profiling (py-spy, Nsight, Xcode Instruments, RenderDoc).

  • Developer tooling, test infrastructure, or CI at scale.

  • Enough fluency with JIT compilation, code generation, or GPU computing stacks to reason about compilation caching, kernel dispatch, and startup cost. You will work closely with Quadrants.

  • At ease debugging across the full platform matrix: Windows, Linux, and macOS, on x86 and arm64, over CUDA, AMD, and Apple Metal (and possibly Intel XPU via Vulkan soon)

  • Open-source reflexes: triaging issues, reviewing external pull requests, communicating with a community.

Bonus points: experience with other robotics simulators (Drake, MuJoCo, Newton, Isaac, RaiSim, Jiminy, Brax). PyTorch, our user-facing interface. Other JIT compilers such as Triton, JAX, or Numba. 3D tooling and interactive editors (Maya, Blender, Houdini). Serialization formats (USD, glTF, MJCF/URDF). C++, CUDA, or Metal. Developer relations or community work.

amo is a Paris-based consumer social company. We want to build Europe's most ambitious consumer company. Our apps Bump and Sugar are used by millions of people all over the globe.

We're scaling fast, and this comes with legal implications. We want them handled in a way that speeds the business up.

The role:

We're hiring our first General Counsel to own amo's legal function end to end. This is a business role, not a support function: you'll work directly with the cofounders, join discussions from the start and work with every team, from Product and Distribution to People, Engineering and Finance.

You'll draft, negotiate and advise yourself on the topics that matter most. For everything else, you'll build and run a network of local counsel, with the right firm for each topic and each market, and turn their advice into clear decisions for the team.

How we think about legal:

At amo, legal starts from the product, to serve our users. We're not looking for someone who applies the rules by the book, but for someone who understands what we're building and why, and finds the legal approach that makes sense for it. You'll be judged on what you enable, not on how many memos you write.

  • Product and users first: you join discussions early and work with the team toward the same goal: making projects to life, fast and safe.

- About Quandela:

Quandela is a European deeptech scale-up developing modular, scalable and energy-efficient photonic and spin-optical quantum computers, accessible through the cloud and on-premises.

With over 140 employees, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and algorithms.

Our ambition is to build large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers, combining quantum dot technologies, scalable spin-photon interfaces and distributed entanglement within future Spin-Optical Quantum Computing (SPOQC) architectures.

- About this position:

You will join Quandela's Semiconductor Optics Team, bringing together expertise in quantum optics, spin physics, semiconductor technologies and quantum information.

Your focus will be to develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols, improve spin coherence and operation fidelity, and advance optical control techniques for future hybrid quantum computing architectures.

We are looking for an experienced experimental scientist who can independently drive complex experimental activities, shape technical directions and translate scientific results into reliable technological building blocks, working closely with our research and engineering teams.

With several experimental building blocks still under development, you'll have room to shape technical choices, tackle open scientific challenges and directly influence our technology roadmap.

- What you'll do:

Spin-based quantum experiments

  • Design, develop and optimize optical experiments involving spin-photon sources.
  • Implement optical control schemes for spin initialization, readout and manipulation.
  • Characterize spin coherence, operation fidelity and entanglement quality.

Scientific and experimental ownership

  • Independently drive experimental investigations, from design to validation.
  • Structure and prioritize scientific activities, milestones and technical challenges.
  • Troubleshoot complex experimental systems and propose technical improvements.
  • Share expertise and support less experienced colleagues when relevant.

Technology development and integration

  • Develop and validate photon-mediated spin-spin entanglement protocols.
  • Collaborate with theory, electronics and semiconductor technology teams.
  • Improve experimental robustness, reproducibility and system performance.
  • Translate scientific results into demonstrators and technological building blocks for future multi-spin architectures.

- How You Will Grow:

During your first 3 months 
You will become familiar with Quandela's experimental platforms and ongoing demonstrators, contributing your expertise to current technical challenges.

Within 6 months 
You will drive dedicated experimental workstreams, contribute to key technical decisions and strengthen theory-to-experiment feedback loops.

Within 1 year 
You will help shape the team's experimental direction, advance distributed entanglement demonstrations and contribute to future spin-based architectures.

Requirements

- What we're looking for

We are looking for an experienced experimental researcher combining strong scientific expertise, technical autonomy and the ability to drive complex research activities.

Must-have

  • PhD in Spin Physics, Quantum Optics or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience with spin-based quantum systems (control, readout or coherence measurements).
  • Proven autonomy in designing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex quantum experiments.
  • Strong understanding of quantum optics, spin coherence and experimental measurement techniques.
  • Ability to lead scientific activities and make independent technical decisions.
  • Comfortable collaborating across experimental, theory and engineering teams

Important, but you can grow here

  • Photon-mediated entanglement protocols and multi-spin architectures.
  • Semiconductor quantum emitters, quantum dots and spin-photon interfaces.
  • Advanced optical control, cryogenic platforms and fast electronics.
  • Experimental qualification, system integration and technology transfer.

Bonus points

  • Experience bridging academic research and industrial R&D.
  • Experience coordinating scientific projects or mentoring researchers.

- Career Stage & Team Contribution: 

We primarily target candidates with a PhD and 4+ years of postdoctoral or equivalent R&D experience, combining scientific expertise with strong experimental autonomy.

Researchers completing a substantial postdoc are also welcome if they demonstrate scientific maturity, technical ownership and readiness for broader responsibilities.

People management experience is not required. What matters is your ability to drive scientific activities, tackle complex technical challenges and share your expertise with the team.

Benefits

  • Profit-sharing and a company savings plan. 
  • Public transport subscription covered at 50%. 
  • Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car). 
  • Fully covered health insurance (Alan). 
  • Referral program (€1,000 for a junior and €2,000 for an experienced candidate). 
  • Access to a nursery via choisir-ma-creche or contribution to childcare expenses. 
  • Subsidy for gym membership and sports activities (Gymlib). 
  • Meal subsidies (Swile). 

 Localisation of the position : Based at the IPVF campus in Palaiseau, within the Paris-Saclay research ecosystem. 

Process: 

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30–45 min)
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45–60 min)
  • Technical discussion and presentation of previous research work
  • Meeting with the team and scientific discussion
  • Reference checks
  • Offer

- Beyond That

At Quandela, you'll work on challenging scientific questions while helping turn experimental advances into technologies for future quantum computers.

Our spin-based platforms are still evolving, leaving room to explore new approaches, influence technical directions and take real ownership of experimental challenges.

If you're excited by the idea of combining ambitious quantum research with tangible technological impact, we'd love to hear from you, even if your background doesn't match every requirement.

About Kog

At Kog, we're building real-time LLM inference for AI agents.

Coding agents execute sequences of tasks where each step depends on the model's previous response. The faster the model generates tokens, the faster these agents can reason, code, and act.

Our approach is to co-design model architecture, the inference engine, and low-level GPU kernels to minimize generation latency on standard NVIDIA and AMD datacenter GPUs.

We've developed several technologies to make this possible:

  • Monokernel: a persistent GPU program that keeps the entire token generation loop on the GPU, avoiding CPU handoffs.

  • KCCL: our custom inter-GPU communication layer, designed to minimize latency.

  • Delayed Tensor Parallelism (DTP): a model architecture that overlaps communication with computation and weight loading.

  • Laneformer 2B: our code-generation model demonstrating this co-design approach.

Our engineers work directly with GPU hardware, using CUDA, PTX, HIP, and CDNA ISA to optimize execution.

Implementing and optimizing a new AI model for a specific GPU architecture can take months of manual engineering. Meanwhile, new models are constantly being released.

Our goal is to use AI agents to implement and optimize the models we choose on the GPUs we choose, in a fraction of the time required today.

These agents will build on the GPU optimizations and hardware insights our team has developed. They'll explore optimization strategies, generate and modify kernels, verify correctness, benchmark performance on real hardware, and iterate based on the results.

We want to make model porting and GPU optimization much faster and repeatable, allowing Kog to keep pace with the latest AI models rather than spending months adapting each one manually.

This is a major engineering direction we're now developing, and you'll help shape it.

Learn more at https://blog.kog.ai.

What you'll work on

You'll join our GPU engineering team to tackle challenging performance problems and help build the internal agents that will accelerate this work.

  • Develop and optimize GPU kernels using C++, CUDA, HIP, and low-level instructions.

  • Investigate GPU architecture, memory access, synchronization, and execution bottlenecks.

  • Profile and benchmark workloads to identify and validate performance improvements.

  • Optimize inference operations and communication across multiple GPUs.

  • Implement and optimize new AI models on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs.

  • Help build AI agents for GPU engineering, enabling automated code optimization, correctness testing, benchmarking, and iterative improvements.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and their implementation.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an experienced GPU Engineer who can contribute quickly and independently to complex performance problems.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and optimizing GPU kernels, ideally using CUDA C++ or HIP/ROCm.

  • Deep understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, parallel execution, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Strong C++ skills and experience profiling and benchmarking GPU workloads.

  • Proven ownership of challenging technical projects, from implementation to measured results.

  • Interest in developing AI agents and tools to accelerate GPU engineering.

Experience with PTX, CDNA ISA, multi-GPU systems, low-latency inference, or GPU performance portability is particularly valuable.

A PhD in HPC, computer science, or a related field is a plus when backed by substantial engineering work. Previous experience building AI agents is not required.

About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse.

We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team.

The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department.

The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities.

• Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments.

• Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent.

• Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes.

• Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers.

• Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings.

• Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements.

What you need to be successful:

• Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python; experience with additional scripting languages is an advantage.

• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation.

• Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution.

• Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Soft Skills:

• Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving.

• Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package.

• Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams.

• Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment.

Other useful skills:

• Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization.

• Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers.

• Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation.

• Familiarity with Git or another version-control system.

• Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required.

• Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage.

Supervision and collaboration:

The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization. Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions. Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values. Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

data.description:
About Sonio

Each year, 140M children are born. Birth defects affect 1 in 33 births in developed countries, and in 50% of cases, they are not detected during prenatal examinations. Prenatal medicine is particularly complex, and the scans impose heavy responsibilities on healthcare professionals. They can also be a source of stress for future parents.

Resulting from 5 years of collaboration between world-renowned experts from Necker Hospital and Ecole Polytechnique, Sonio uses artificial intelligence to improve prenatal screening and diagnosis. Based on patented algorithms and a proprietary expert database, Sonio aims to become the reference tool to help practitioners improve screening, reduce diagnostic errors, and optimize pregnant women’s medical path.

Sonio's mission is to improve women's and children's health by promoting access and quality of care through technological innovation, medical expertise, and collective intelligence.

About the role


We are looking for a DevOps / Platform Engineering intern to join our Platform team (DevOps, Data and Staff Engineers), which runs the infrastructure behind our SaaS platform. As the platform grows, so do our internal operational requests. Your mission will be to find out how far AI agents can take this RUN work off our plate, without giving up control.


Your main mission will be to:

  • Build an AI agent that turns internal infrastructure requests (provisioning a new service, managing AWS resources and access, environment variables or app configuration, Kubernetes or ArgoCD resources) into ready-to-review GitHub Pull Requests:

    1. Understand. The agent parses the request and picks the matching runbook.

    2. Generate. It produces the Terraform, Kubernetes or ArgoCD changes in our IaC repositories.

    3. Validate. It runs automated checks: tests, linting, and security and misconfiguration scans.

    4. Propose. It opens a traceable Pull Request for human review and approval.

  • Design the guardrails that make this safe: least-privilege access, approval steps, and predictable, repeatable runs. The AI never changes production on its own, and engineers stay in control of every change,

  • Deliver a working proof of concept on real internal requests, built so it can grow into a production-ready tool.

The AI never changes production on its own. Engineers stay in control, and every change is reviewed, tested and traceable.


Our infrastructure stack

  • Cloud: AWS, multi-region

  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform

  • Containers & GitOps: Kubernetes on EKS, Helm, ArgoCD

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Observability: Datadog

  • Security & Compliance: vulnerability and misconfiguration scanning, least-privilege IAM, and a HITRUST/SOC2-driven change process

  • Backend: Elixir/Phoenix

About the profile


Sonio is a mission-driven company so interest in our mission is critical. Other requirements are:

  • Currently in Master 2 / Bac+5 of Engineering School or University, you are majoring in Computer Science and are looking for an internship lasting between 5 and 6 months,

  • Good knowledge of AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, and Git and CI/CD workflows,

  • Solid scripting skills (Python or similar) and a security-minded approach to infrastructure changes,

  • Strong interest in AI agents and LLMs applied to real engineering problems,

  • Experience with ArgoCD, Helm or Datadog is a plus,

  • You speak English and ideally French.

We move fast and aspire to be transparent over the process - our objective is that the process from the first chat to an offer is no longer than a month. We also aspire to give an answer to every application in a week - if you have not heard from us, please follow up at -----

About Inbolt

Deploying an industrial robot still takes months of integration and programming, and the moment a part, a process, or a position changes, it starts over. Inbolt makes it take minutes.

Our generalist vision model gives robots the ability to see, think, and adapt in real time, so any robot can master any process, part, or station. Set up from a CAD model in minutes and compatible with FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau, and Universal Robots, Inbolt runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM, Bosch and more, with 200+ systems live across 100+ factories on three continents.

We're a team based in Paris, Detroit and Japan, and we're growing fast. Here's the role:

As our Associate Product Manager Intern, you will sit at the crossroads of our customers, our sales team and our engineers. Working alongside our Product Lead, you will make sure that what we build answers real business needs: you will gather what customers and the field are telling us, translate it into clear product priorities and specs, and give Sales and Ops the material they need to sell and deploy Inbolt with confidence. In short, your mission is to turn the work of our 20 engineers into value our customers understand and buy.

🎯 Responsibilities

  • Collect and structure customer feedback, feature requests and field issues coming from Sales, Ops and client sites, and turn them into clear, prioritized specs the engineering team can act on.

  • Build a solid understanding of our market: customer use cases, buyer personas in automotive and manufacturing, and how competitors position themselves.

  • Help quantify the business value of new features (time saved, cost avoided, ROI for the customer) to support prioritization and sales arguments.

  • Create sales enablement material with the Sales team: product one-pagers, demo scripts, FAQs and objection handling.

  • Own the product documentation for Inbolt Studio, from the internal knowledge base to release notes and client-facing guides.

  • Organize how each release is shared across the company (release notes, internal demos, training sessions), so that everyone can talk about the product.

  • Take part in product testing before releases and report bugs precisely and reproducibly.

✍️ Position details

  • Team: Product

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Start date: January to March 2027, flexible with your school calendar

  • Contract: 6-month full-time internship, end-of-studies internship (stage de fin d’études) or gap year (césure)

  • Work mode: Hybrid in Paris, with at least one customer site visit during the internship

🔎 Preferred experience

Inbolt values end-to-end ownership, high rigor, and a hands-on curiosity. We move fast while staying precise, with a proactive, autonomous, results-driven mindset and strong collaboration with engineering teams.

  • Final-year student in a business school, engineering school or university Master’s program, or on a gap year, available for 6 months. We do not filter on school or track.

  • A strong business sense: you naturally ask who the customer is, what problem they pay to solve and how we win against alternatives.

  • You write clearly about technical topics for people who are not engineers. This is the skill that matters most here, and we test it during the process.

  • You are curious about machines: why this robot stopped, why that part was missed.

  • You work autonomously, and you say “I don’t know, let me find out” instead of guessing.

  • Fluent in English and French.

💫 Additional plus

  • A first experience in a B2B tech, deep tech or industrial environment (product, sales operations, consulting, QA, technical support, application engineering).

  • Experience talking directly with customers or users, through interviews, support or sales.

  • Comfortable with tools like Notion and Linear, and with basic 3D or CAD concepts.

  • You have already built documentation, a market study, a test plan or a process from scratch.

✨ Benefits

  • 📍 Prime office location in Paris

  • 🤝 Team-building events & off-sites

  • 🐶 Bring-your-dog-to-work policy

  • 🍽️ Meal: lunch expenses covered

  • 💪 Gymlib: subscription fully covered

  • ✈️ Travel: customer site visit(s) in a real factory

Interview process

  • HR call (30 min) with Inès, Talent Partner

  • Case study and technical interview (1h) with Helena, Product Lead, or Jean, Head of Engineering

  • Team interview (30 min) with engineers from the team you will work with every day

  • Founders interview (30 min) with Rudy, CEO

  • Reference checks (if applicable)

Why join Inbolt

  • Real impact, on real factory floors: your work runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM and Bosch, across 100+ factories on three continents.

  • Ownership from day one: we value end-to-end ownership, high rigor and hands-on curiosity, and we move fast while staying precise.

  • An international team: Paris, Detroit and Japan, working closely with world-class robotics and automation partners.

  • A seat at the start of something big: we're building the default intelligence layer for every industrial robot, on every brand.

✨ Benefits

  • 📍 Prime office locations in Paris and Detroit

  • 🤝 Team-building events & off-sites

  • 🐶 Bring-your-dog-to-work policy

  • 🍽️ Lunch expenses covered

Benefits may vary by location and contract type.

  • Introduction call (30 min) with our Talent team, to get to know you and answer your questions.

  • Interview with your future manager, including a case study or technical exercise depending on the role.

  • Meet the team: a conversation with the people you will work with every day.

  • Final round with our founders.

  • Reference checks.

The exact steps can vary slightly by role. We keep the process short and transparent, and we'll keep you posted at every step.

Ready to give robots sight?

Inbolt is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from everyone, whatever their background, and a real person reads every application. Even if you don't tick every box, if this role excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

Alassio recrute son ou sa Account Executive Cabinets (Paris) !

En un coup d’œil

  • Contrat : CDI, à pourvoir dès que possible

  • Lieu : Paris ; déplacements locaux dans Paris uniquement ; hybride

  • Périmètre : Paris exclusivement, sans tournées régionales

  • Expérience : 3-5 ans minimum en vente full cycle SaaS B2B

 
 

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d’expertise-comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio accélère pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l’accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Pour accompagner cette accélération, nous cherchons un·e Account Executive Cabinets sur le périmètre Paris exclusivement, sans tournées régionales : un profil commercial qui aime prospecter, comprendre des enjeux métier exigeants et transformer une relation de confiance en signature.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu développes ton portefeuille de cabinets en full cycle, de la prospection au closing. Tu es responsable de ton pipeline et de tes opportunités, avec l’appui des équipes Product, Tech, Déploiement et Accompagnement (DnA).

 

🧭 Tes missions

Prospecter et créer tes opportunités

  • Prendre en charge l’inbound de ton périmètre : qualifier les demandes, mener les découvertes, traiter les sollicitations avec réactivité et assurer des relances structurées

  • Identifier les cabinets à potentiel et construire une prospection ciblée via les canaux adaptés : online, événementiel, mises en relation et rencontres terrain

  • Combiner appels, emails, mises en relation et rendez-vous pour ouvrir de nouvelles conversations

Qualifier, démontrer et conclure

  • Comprendre l’organisation du cabinet, ses usages, ses irritants et ses enjeux de changement de logiciel de paie

  • Qualifier les besoins, les interlocuteurs, le processus de décision et le calendrier du projet

  • Préparer et mener des démonstrations adaptées, en mobilisant les expertises internes lorsque nécessaire

  • Piloter chaque étape du cycle : suivi des échanges, traitement des objections, proposition commerciale, négociation et closing

  • Maintenir un pipeline fiable, avec des prochaines étapes claires et des prévisions commerciales argumentées

  • Préparer une transmission fluide aux équipes Déploiement et Accompagnement (DnA) pour que les engagements pris pendant la vente soient compris et partagés

Développer une présence terrain sur ton périmètre

Organiser des rendez-vous dans les cabinets parisiens, rencontrer les décideurs et développer un réseau local de cabinets et de prescripteurs. Représenter Alassio lors de salons et d’événements du secteur comptable et social à Paris, puis assurer le suivi commercial des contacts. Articuler rendez-vous en présentiel et échanges à distance : les déplacements sont locaux, dans Paris uniquement.

Contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

  • Participer aux points d’équipe, aux revues de pipeline et aux échanges de pratiques

  • Partager les objections, les signaux marché et les apprentissages utiles au collectif dans une organisation lean et product-led

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des messages, des supports et des méthodes commerciales, sans perdre de vue tes objectifs principaux

 

🛠️ Une collaboration rapprochée avec la Tech et le Product

Chez Alassio, les Sales ne travaillent pas à distance du produit. Tu échanges régulièrement avec les équipes Tech et Product pour comprendre ce que nous construisons, préparer les démonstrations, éclaircir les cas d’usage et faire remonter les besoins du terrain avec précision.

Tu sais contextualiser les contraintes d’un cabinet, distinguer un besoin d’une demande de fonctionnalité et aligner ton discours commercial sur les capacités réelles du produit, sans promettre ce qui n’est pas validé.

 

🤖 Notre OS interne au quotidien

CRM, documentation partagée, IA et automatisations sont des leviers pour mieux prospecter, préparer tes rendez-vous et assurer ton suivi. Tu prends rapidement en main de nouveaux outils, documentes tes échanges, maintiens une information fiable et partages les pratiques qui rendent l’équipe plus efficace.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans la vente full cycle en SaaS B2B, sur des cycles impliquant plusieurs interlocuteurs et du présentiel

  • Une autonomie de lead generation : tu sais créer tes opportunités et mener une prospection régulière, sans attendre qu’on t’alimente en leads

  • Une capacité à conduire une découverte approfondie, démontrer la valeur, assurer le suivi commercial et négocier jusqu’à la signature

  • Une connaissance de l’écosystème comptable ou de la paie est un plus ; l’anglais professionnel est apprécié

  • Des notions ou une expérience passée dans la vente indirecte sont un plus

 

🛠️ Compétences et outils

  • Une forte appétence pour la collaboration avec les équipes Tech et Product, au-delà de la simple remontée de demandes clients

  • Une grande agilité avec les outils numériques, l’IA et les automatisations, associée à une utilisation rigoureuse de notre OS interne. Tu comprends l’importance de la data pour une approche méthodique

  • Une curiosité réelle pour les métiers de la paie et les enjeux des cabinets, avec l’envie de monter en compétence sur un produit à forte profondeur métier

 

💎 Qualités

  • Autonomie, proactivité et esprit collectif : tu avances sur tes objectifs tout en contribuant à la vie de l’équipe

  • Le goût du terrain et l’envie de développer un portefeuille exclusivement parisien, avec des rencontres locales

  • Data-driven et pragmatique : nous prenons des décisions basées sur des métriques précises et métier

  • Clarté, curiosité et esprit de coopération pour travailler avec les équipes et les cabinets

 
 

Processus de sélection

1️⃣ Premier entretien avec Maxime, Head of Sales 1h

2️⃣ Business case à partir de situations réelles avec Tancrède (CEO), Alexandre (Déploiement & Accompagnement) et Maxime - en présentiel 📍

3️⃣ Approfondissement métier et motivations avec Alexandre (Partner Success) et Maxime 1h

4️⃣ Prises de références

5️⃣ Rencontre avec l’équipe dans nos bureaux, en présentiel 1h

 
 

Ce que nous offrons

 

👊 Une mission au contact du terrain et du produit

Un rôle commercial full cycle au contact des cabinets, du produit et de l’équipe, pour accompagner la croissance d’Alassio sur Paris exclusivement, sans tournées régionales.

 

🎁 Rémunération et avantages

  • 💰 Rémunération compétitive + BSPCE

  • 🏥 Mutuelle Alan

  • 🍽️ Carte Swile (tickets restaurant)

  • 💻 Matériel de pointe (MacOS, écran incurvé)

  • 🏝️ RTT

 

Prochaines étapes : ----- ; -----

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d’expertise-comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio accélère pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l’accompagnement.

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Pour accompagner cette accélération, nous cherchons un·e Account Executive Cabinets sur le périmètre Paris–Marseille : un profil commercial qui aime prospecter, comprendre des enjeux métier exigeants et transformer une relation de confiance en signature.

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu développes ton portefeuille de cabinets en full cycle, de la prospection au closing. Tu es responsable de ton pipeline et de tes opportunités, avec l’appui des équipes Product, Tech, Déploiement et Accompagnement (DnA).

 

🧭 Tes missions

Prospecter et créer tes opportunités

  • Prendre en charge l’inbound de ton périmètre : qualifier les demandes, mener les découvertes, traiter les sollicitations avec réactivité et assurer des relances structurées

  • Identifier les cabinets à potentiel et construire une prospection ciblée via les canaux adaptés : online, événementiel, mises en relation et rencontres terrain

  • Combiner appels, emails, mises en relation et rendez-vous pour ouvrir de nouvelles conversations

Qualifier, démontrer et conclure

  • Comprendre l’organisation du cabinet, ses usages, ses irritants et ses enjeux de changement de logiciel de paie

  • Qualifier les besoins, les interlocuteurs, le processus de décision et le calendrier du projet

  • Préparer et mener des démonstrations adaptées, en mobilisant les expertises internes lorsque nécessaire

  • Piloter chaque étape du cycle : suivi des échanges, traitement des objections, proposition commerciale, négociation et closing

  • Maintenir un pipeline fiable, avec des prochaines étapes claires et des prévisions commerciales argumentées

  • Préparer une transmission fluide aux équipes Déploiement et Accompagnement (DnA) pour que les engagements pris pendant la vente soient compris et partagés

Développer une présence terrain sur ton périmètre

Rencontrer régulièrement les cabinets et leurs décideurs sur l’axe Paris–Marseille, développer ton réseau et représenter Alassio lors de salons et d’événements du secteur comptable et social. Transformer les rencontres en opportunités qualifiées et organiser tes tournées pour conjuguer proximité client et efficacité commerciale. Les déplacements fréquents sur l’axe Paris–Marseille font partie du poste.

Contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

  • Participer aux points d’équipe, aux revues de pipeline et aux échanges de pratiques

  • Partager les objections, les signaux marché et les apprentissages utiles au collectif dans une organisation lean et product-led

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des messages, des supports et des méthodes commerciales, sans perdre de vue tes objectifs principaux

 

🛠️ Une collaboration rapprochée avec la Tech et le Product

Chez Alassio, les Sales ne travaillent pas à distance du produit. Tu échanges régulièrement avec les équipes Tech et Product pour comprendre ce que nous construisons, préparer les démonstrations, éclaircir les cas d’usage et faire remonter les besoins du terrain avec précision.

Tu sais contextualiser les contraintes d’un cabinet, distinguer un besoin d’une demande de fonctionnalité et aligner ton discours commercial sur les capacités réelles du produit, sans promettre ce qui n’est pas validé.

 

🤖 Notre OS interne au quotidien

CRM, documentation partagée, IA et automatisations sont des leviers pour mieux prospecter, préparer tes rendez-vous et assurer ton suivi. Tu prends rapidement en main de nouveaux outils, documentes tes échanges, maintiens une information fiable et partages les pratiques qui rendent l’équipe plus efficace.

 
 

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans la vente full cycle en SaaS B2B, sur des cycles impliquant plusieurs interlocuteurs et du présentiel

  • Une autonomie de lead generation : tu sais créer tes opportunités et mener une prospection régulière, sans attendre qu’on t’alimente en leads

  • Une capacité à conduire une découverte approfondie, démontrer la valeur, assurer le suivi commercial et négocier jusqu’à la signature

  • Une connaissance de l’écosystème comptable ou de la paie est un plus ; l’anglais professionnel est apprécié

  • Des notions ou une expérience passée dans la vente indirecte sont un plus

 

🛠️ Compétences et outils

  • Une forte appétence pour la collaboration avec les équipes Tech et Product, au-delà de la simple remontée de demandes clients

  • Une grande agilité avec les outils numériques, l’IA et les automatisations, associée à une utilisation rigoureuse de notre OS interne. Tu comprends l’importance de la data pour une approche méthodique

  • Une curiosité réelle pour les métiers de la paie et les enjeux des cabinets, avec l’envie de monter en compétence sur un produit à forte profondeur métier

 

💎 Qualités

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a UI Designer to craft intuitive, elegant and high-performing interfaces for BJAK's AI and financial products.

This role is for someone who obsesses over visual quality, interaction details and usability. You'll work closely with product managers and engineers to design mobile-first experiences that make complex financial products feel simple, trustworthy and enjoyable to use.

What You'll Own

  • Design polished, user-centric interfaces for mobile and web products.

  • Transform product requirements into wireframes, user flows, prototypes and high-fidelity UI.

  • Build intuitive experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and other financial services.

  • Maintain and evolve BJAK's design system to ensure consistency across products.

  • Collaborate closely with product managers and engineers to deliver pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Iterate designs using user feedback, analytics and usability testing.

  • Ensure accessibility, responsiveness and visual consistency across different devices and platforms.

  • Contribute to improving overall product usability, interaction patterns and visual language.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–5 years of experience designing digital products, with a strong focus on mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual design, interaction design and UI craftsmanship.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and modern design workflows.

  • Strong understanding of mobile-first design principles, platform guidelines (iOS & Android) and responsive layouts.

  • Good understanding of UX principles, information architecture and user-centred design.

  • Ability to simplify complex user journeys into intuitive interfaces.

  • High attention to detail with strong visual hierarchy, typography and spacing.

  • Portfolio is required. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Design Tools

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • Auto Layout & Components

  • Design Tokens

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in complete user journeys, not just beautiful screens.

  • Obsesses over clarity, consistency and usability.

  • Designs interfaces that reduce friction and build user trust.

  • Works closely with engineers to ensure designs are implemented accurately.

  • Moves quickly while maintaining a high standard of visual quality.

  • Takes ownership of problems instead of waiting for detailed instructions.

This Role Is Not For

  • Designers who focus only on aesthetics without considering usability.

  • People who copy trends without understanding user problems.

  • Designers who struggle to collaborate with product and engineering teams.

  • Individuals who require extensive direction before making design decisions.

  • Candidates who cannot clearly explain the rationale behind their design choices or their individual contributions.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Switzerland. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Switzerland.

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Portfolio review

  2. Practical design task (if applicable)

  3. Role-specific interview

  4. CEO / Final interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines: turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

What you'll do

  • Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

  • Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

  • Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

  • Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

  • You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

  • Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

  • Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

  • Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

Example projects

  • Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

  • Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes.

  • Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest.

data.description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a data engine for clinical trial intelligence. It provides data infrastructure and AI-driven workflows for clinical trial teams, enabling biotechs to run studies more efficiently and to demonstrate which patients derive the greatest benefit from new therapies. Biopharma companies are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is frequently slowed by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia delivers a real-time, integrated view across clinical trial data, improving both trial execution and the evaluation of new treatments.

 

Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost.

 

We seek highly self-motivated, motivated and talented professionals to contribute to our growing startup.

 

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Customer Success to lead and scale how Rivia delivers value to customers. As our first dedicated Customer Success leader, you will oversee the post-sales journey, from onboarding and technical implementation through adoption, retention, and long-term account growth.

You will lead Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering, build a repeatable operating model, and stay close to strategic biotech and pharmaceutical customers. You will combine scientific and technical credibility with strong people leadership, commercial judgment, and a builder’s mindset.

Ownership and Commercial Collaboration

Customer Success owns the post-sales customer relationship, implementation, adoption, measurable value realization, customer health, retention strategy, and renewal readiness. The They will be accountable for customer outcomes and for proactively identifying and developing expansion opportunities.

Sales owns the commercial pipeline and execution of renewal and upsell transactions, including commercial negotiations and closing. The Head of Customer Success partners closely with Sales to shape account strategies, quantify customer value, identify and qualify opportunities, manage renewal risks, and support successful commercial outcomes.


What excites you

  • Building something from the ground up. You're excited by the opportunity to shape and scale a Customer Success function, creating the structure, processes, and standards that will support Rivia's next stage of growth.

  • Making a real impact on drug development. You're motivated by working at the intersection of life sciences and technology, helping biotech companies make better decisions and accelerate clinical development.

  • Being close to customers. You enjoy understanding complex scientific and technical challenges, building trusted relationships, and translating customer needs into meaningful outcomes.

  • Combining leadership with hands-on execution. You love developing high-performing teams but are equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves, solving difficult problems, and taking ownership of strategic accounts.

  • Driving measurable business impact. You're energized by improving customer retention, demonstrating value, and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships in close partnership with Sales.

  • Thriving in a fast-paced environment. You enjoy autonomy, ambitious goals, and the opportunity to influence decisions directly, without waiting for someone else to tell you what to do.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and coach the Customer Engagement and Solutions Engineering teams, setting clear standards for performance, development, capacity planning, and hiring.

  • Build and scale the end-to-end post-sales experience, including onboarding, implementation, technical delivery, success plans, executive business reviews, escalation management, and value realization.

  • Own customer health, adoption, retention strategy, and renewal readiness; partner with Sales on renewal and expansion planning and execution.

  • Oversee complex implementations, integration quality, delivery timelines, and smooth handoffs from Sales.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior scientific, technical, and business stakeholders at biotech and pharma customers.

  • Translate platform usage into measurable outcomes, including time saved, costs avoided, and operational improvements.

  • Define and monitor customer success metrics, including adoption, time to value, GRR, NRR, renewal performance, and expansion opportunities.

  • Resolve critical customer escalations and translate recurring feedback into priorities for Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.

  • Introduce scalable account segmentation, coverage models, reporting, and operating rhythms without unnecessary bureaucracy.

What excites us:

  • Experience leading and developing customer-facing teams in a B2B technology environment, while remaining personally close to customers.

  • A background in life sciences, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, pharmaceutical development, or a closely related scientific field.

  • Experience with biotech, pharma, clinical development, scientific software, or other complex life-sciences technology customers.

  • Evidence of driving customer retention, renewals, adoption, and account expansion through cross-functional collaboration.

  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics and customer success metrics, including GRR, NRR, customer health, and renewal rates.

  • Ability to navigate technical implementations, manage executive escalations, and influence senior stakeholders.

  • A structured, hands-on leadership style, commercial judgment, direct communication, and urgency in a fast-moving environment.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Experience building a Customer Success function at an early-stage or Series A company.

  • Deep familiarity with clinical trials, clinical data, or pharmaceutical R&D workflows.

  • Experience supporting strategic expansion in enterprise biotech or pharmaceutical accounts.

  • A track record of measurable improvements in retention, adoption, and customer outcomes.

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team.

  • In it to Win it: Approach challenges with determination, resilience, and drive.

  • Embrace change: See change as an opportunity to improve.

  • Why not?: Challenge assumptions and stay curious.

  • Find the gap: Proactively identify and solve problems.

  • Collective accountability: Own outcomes together and support one another.

  • Value add solutions: Deliver meaningful, impactful results.

Gesucht werden Personen mit ausgewiesener Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung komplexer Enterprise- und Plattformarchitekturen. Erwartet wird insbesondere die Fähigkeit, strategische Zielbilder in konkrete Architekturentscheidungen, Standards, Plattformfähigkeiten und umsetzbare Roadmaps zu überführen.

  • Erfahrung in der Spezifikation von Services und in der Evaluation von Produkten anhand strukturierter Kriterien

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

About the role

BLP’s AI agents are only as good as their data: they need reliable context from our customers’ ERP systems, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, or Oracle, and a safe way to write their results back.

We are forming a new backend platform team, and you will be one of its first engineers. You will start by learning our existing data synchronization platform, keeping it reliable, and gradually taking ownership of it. From there, you will build the backend services and tooling that let BLP connect to any ERP system through configuration instead of custom code.

What you'll do

  • Shape the platform: work with the engineers and implementation teams who connect our customers’ ERP systems, find where that work is slow or fragile, and turn it into platform improvements.

  • Lead technically: drive technical decisions on key initiatives, influence the product roadmap, and support your teammates as they grow.

  • Improve how we work: share what you learn openly and keep improving our processes, tools, and team practices.

  • Tech stack: Go, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub CI/CD, running on GCP.

What you bring

  • 3+ years as a software engineer, with a degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience with Go, or strong backend experience and the motivation to learn Go quickly

  • Craftsmanship: a solid grasp of Clean Code and Clean Architecture

  • Product thinking: you turn business problems into precise requirements, specifications, and ultimately code

  • Ownership: you take responsibility for your code, the product, and the team

  • Clear communication: you simplify complex systems and explain them to engineers and business stakeholders alike

  • Fluent English: you work comfortably in English, in writing and in conversation

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, GCP and infrastructure as code.

  • German.

What you'll get

  • Real leverage: every improvement you make to the platform speeds up go-lives and stabilizes integrations for hundreds of enterprise customers.

  • Full ownership: from internal user problem to shipped and operated code.

  • A modern, varied tech stack and continuous learning as the platform scales.

  • Fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.

  • Regular team events.

About Poesis

Whoever builds the leading intelligence for finance will create far more than returns. Poesis is the AI-native investment firm running autonomous agents that predict markets, construct portfolios, and manage risk. Our founders managed institutional capital at Capital Group ($3T AUM) and led enterprise ML at Goldman Sachs and Amazon. We're building a new type of firm, where live capital is the training ground for an intelligence that compounds with every signal.

About the Role

Financial markets offer something rare in AI research: a continuous, objective feedback loop where you can test new ideas, measure whether they actually work, and use real-world outcomes to inform what you build next. It’s an opportunity to do frontier research with a direct line between the ideas you explore and their real-world performance. As Head of AI, you’ll lead Poesis’s AI strategy and research, setting the technical direction for how we apply frontier AI to investing. You’ll explore new AI approaches, tackle difficult research problems and help define how we use AI to better understand and predict financial markets. This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll set the research agenda while continuing to work directly on technical challenges.

Challenges You’ll Work On

  • Set Poesis’s AI research direction, identify the hardest problems worth solving and guide the team's technical work.

  • Push the capabilities of foundation models, agentic systems and world models through new architectures and research approaches.

  • Explore pre-training, mid-training and post-training methods to improve how models learn, reason and adapt.

  • Advance tabular ML research, including emerging methods such as prior-data fitted networks (PFNs).

  • Tackle the challenges of learning from small, high-dimensional datasets where traditional ML methods struggle.

  • Turn promising research into models and systems that can solve difficult real-world problems.


About You

  • You’ve done exceptional AI research at a frontier AI lab, leading research initiatives and helping set technical direction.

  • You have deep expertise in modern AI architectures, model training and machine learning.

  • You have a strong research track record, including relevant publications.

  • You have strong mathematical and statistical foundations and know how to tackle difficult problems with limited, complex data.

  • You’re a hands-on technical leader who can guide other researchers while developing, testing and implementing your own ideas.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with frontier tabular ML methods.

  • Experience applying ML to financial markets or complex, high-dimensional datasets.

Location

Hybrid, 3 days per week on-site at our office in Menlo Park, CA, London, or Zurich. Relocation allowance available.

Compensation

Competitive cash compensation commensurate with experience, plus equity and carry (share of fund profits).

 

Benefits

We offer excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage, alongside a strong benefits package that includes catered lunches, commuter benefits, and more.

For U.S. candidates, current legal authorization to work in the US required; continuing work visa sponsorship available for full-time employees.

Working at Poesis

As an early team member, you’ll help shape not just the product, but how the company operates. Your decisions will have lasting impact across the business. You’ll build from first principles, with no legacy systems, or entrenched processes slowing you down. Our team is made up of people from elite companies and universities who are low ego, collaborative, and excited to build together.

data.description:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About The Role

As the Deployed Engineering Manager for Northern Europe, you will lead a team of deployed engineers from our hub in Amsterdam, working with our customers across DACH and Benelux. You'll help build and shape the team, grow the people in it and make sure our customers get the technical partnership they need to build and run great agents in production. This is an opportunity to have outsized impact at a company shaping the future of AI-powered software.

DEs work alongside our sales team to help our prospects and customers build reliable, scalable agents for their business using our suite of products: LangChain, LangGraph, Deep Agents and LangSmith. The team focuses on pre-sales efforts, but stays on accounts to not only close new business but also to make our customers wildly successful.

Your first job is your people. You will support great deployed engineers, ramp them quickly, coach them through live customer work and build a team where they do the best work of their careers. You'll stay close enough to the technology and to our customers to be credible with both: unblocking your team on hard engagements and stepping in on the region's most important opportunities.

You will report to the Director of Deployed Engineering, EMEA and partner closely with LangChain's sales leaders covering DACH and Benelux, with shared ownership of regional outcomes.

This role is mostly people leadership, with real customer engagement and revenue accountability alongside it. As part of the EMEA deployed engineering leadership team, you'll also bring what you learn back into the playbooks, processes and standards we use globally.

What You'll Do:

  • Grow the DACH/Benelux DE team: support recruiting, interviewing and closing candidates as the team grows and raise the bar with every hire.

  • Onboard and ramp new DEs quickly, with a clear definition of what "ramped" looks like and the support to get each person there.

  • Coach your team through live customer work: join calls, review architectures and proofs of value to provide direct, specific feedback that makes people better.

  • Own performance management: set clear expectations, recognise great work and address underperformance early and fairly.

  • Run the team's operating rhythm: account coverage, capacity and load balancing, deal and engagement reviews and the regional cadence with sales.

  • Partner with sales leadership in DACH and the Benelux on account strategy, coverage and technical win plans, with shared accountability for revenue outcomes and customer success.

  • Bring regional insight to the global DE team: what's working with customers in the region, product feedback and contributions to shared playbooks.

  • Develop future leaders, growing the senior DEs who will lead the next teams in the region.


How to be successful in the role:

  • 7+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles at a dev tools, AI, or infrastructure company.

  • 2+ years managing customer-facing engineers, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

  • A track record of developing people: engineers you hired and grew who went on to bigger scope or roles.

  • Technical credibility with your team and your customers: you're not a stranger to Python, and are well-versed in software engineering, platform engineering and solutions architecture. Hands-on experience building with LLMs or agents is a strong plus.

  • Experience working with or selling to developers and engineering-led buyers and an understanding of how enterprises in the region evaluate and buy (procurement, data protection, hosting and sovereignty requirements).

  • Exceptional communication and technical storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers and coach others to do the same.

  • A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity and a consistently high bar for excellence.

  • Fluent English; German strongly preferred.

  • Must be available to work in Amsterdam, with regular travel across the region.

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.
