data.description:
Een ervaren HR-professional die graag complexe HR-vraagstukken oppakt, kennis deelt, overzicht houdt en bijdraagt aan een goede HR-dienstverlening.

Voor onze volop in beweging zijnde HR administratie/HR-support team zoeken we een ervaren HR-professional die goed thuis is in HR operatie en graag meedenkt over uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor collega’s en steekt zelf graag de handen uit de mouwen. Met een proactieve blik kijk je verder dan de dagelijkse praktijk en zie je kansen om processen te verbeteren. Herken jij jezelf hierin en bouw je graag mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze afdeling? Solliciteer dan snel!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij zorgt er samen met je hr-collega’s voor dat de basis van onze HR-administratie op orde is, maar jouw meerwaarde zit vooral in het behandelen van complexere operationele HR-vraagstukken, het ondersteunen van HR collega’s en het samen met de teamleider verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Je bent een inhoudelijke vraagbaak voor het HR-team en een vertrouwd aanspreekpunt voor NLR medewerkers en HR-adviseurs.

Als senior HR medewerker heb je een veelzijdige rol waarin HR-administratie, dienstverlening, inhoudelijke expertise en procesverbetering samenkomen. Jouw HR collega’s houden zich bezig met de dagelijkse HR-processen, waarbij jij je richt op vooral vraagstukken die meer ervaring, inzicht en zelfstandigheid vragen. Daarnaast deel je actief je kennis met collega's, denk je mee over een slimme verdeling van het werk en draag je bij aan de kwaliteit van onze dienstverlening.

Jouw werkzaamheden in het kort:

  • Vraagbaak voor het HR-team: je behandelt tweedelijns HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden, personeelsregelingen en HR processen, detachering, inleen en deelt je kennis en ondersteunt collega’s.

  • Samenwerken met de teamleider HR: je werkt aan HR-projecten, verbetert processen en bewaakt de voortgang, met name bij piekmomenten.

  • Ondersteunen van de HR Adviseurs en managers: je helpt bij operationele HR-vraagstukken en zorgt voor een goede aansluiting tussen HR-processen en de praktijk.

  • Zorgen voor goede HR-dienstverlening: je bewaakt de kwaliteit van de HR-administratie en hebt contact met medewerkers. Je draagt bij aan een juiste en tijdige verwerking van personeelsgegevens en ondersteunt waar nodig bij eerstelijnsvragen.

  • Bouwen aan de HR-afdeling: je signaleert knelpunten, denkt mee over praktische/operationele verbeteringen, helpt werkprocessen te uniformeren en deelt je kennis met collega's.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken iemand die senioriteit laat zien in zowel gedrag als HR-kennis. Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je hebt een stevige basis, durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming nodig is. First time right is het devies, kwalitatieve en zorgvuldige HR administratie en dienstverlening vinden wij belangrijk.

Verder breng je mee:

  • Afgeronde opleiding in HRM of een vergelijkbare richting met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring binnen HR, bij voorkeur in een brede HR-administratieve functie en kennis van AFAS.

  • Je hebt gedegen kennis van HR administratie en support en ervaring met het zelfstandig behandelen van HR-vraagstukken over bijvoorbeeld arbeidsvoorwaarden en personeelsregelingen.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk, toegankelijk en klantgericht. Je maakt gemakkelijk contact met medewerkers en collega’s op verschillende niveaus.

  • Je werkt graag samen, durft je eigen perspectief in te brengen en staat open voor feedback en andere inzichten.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor details en houdt overzicht en helpt collega’s om werkzaamheden goed en tijdig af te ronden.

  • Je bent gewend en krijgt er energie van om in een snel groeiende en veranderende organisatie te werken.

  • Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk op C1 niveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightechomgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden we je onder andere:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4400,- en € 5000 (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer.

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

Je wordt onderdeel van een breed HR-team met verschillende expertises, van HR-advies en beleid tot recruitment en Learning & Development. We sparren graag met elkaar, houden elkaar scherp en inspireren elkaar om verder te komen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw ideeën, kennis en initiatief, met oog voor elkaar en het gezamenlijke resultaat. Samen werken we aan HR-dienstverlening die aansluit bij de behoeften van de organisatie en bijdraagt aan onze strategische ambities.

Onze HR-afdeling is volop in ontwikkeling en werkt aan verdere professionalisering en verbetering van processen en samenwerking. Dat biedt kansen, maar vraagt ook iets van jou. Je komt terecht in een HR-afdeling waar we volop werken aan het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening. We brengen meer structuur aan, maken onze processen eenvoudiger en werken steeds nauwer samen. Dat betekent dat niet alles al vastligt en dat er ruimte is om mee te denken en dingen slimmer te organiseren. Je standplaats is Amsterdam of Marknesse, maar je bent ook regelmatig op onze andere locatie voor overleg en samenwerking met collega’s.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations. We’re looking for a Product Designer to set the cross-application UX direction for our commercial software - from pharma cold-chain visibility that helps temperature-sensitive medicines move safely around the world, to ULD tracking for airlines. You’ll define a consistent, high-quality experience across our modules and applications and support our specialised designers in bringing that experience to life, while remaining hands-on in discovery, from the first user conversation through to the final UX.

📍 Location: We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with remote working available within these countries. Hybrid option available in the Netherlands.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell?

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

A dedicated framework team owns our Design System and Design Guidelines, while embedded designers craft the screens and flows within each product module. What You'll Bring:

  • Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience as a senior or lead product designer working on complex B2B software, ideally within supply chain, logistics, aviation/air cargo or pharma

  • Strong experience leading discovery, from understanding user needs through research and prototyping to defining and refining UX solutions

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, with experience creating and iterating wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes

  • Ability to communicate UX strategy, priorities and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders

  • Working knowledge of design systems and accessibility standards such as WCAG; experience partnering with design system teams is an advantage

  • Experience designing for multiple user groups, such as pharma quality/logistics teams and airline cargo operations, is beneficial

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's AI Neobank and financial products.

This role is for someone who loves designing mobile interfaces that feel effortless, responsive and visually refined. You'll work alongside engineers and product managers to create experiences used daily by millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.

  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes and production-ready UI.

  • Design mobile experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and financial services.

  • Build and maintain mobile design systems and reusable components.

  • Work closely with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience designing mobile applications.

Design Stack

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Netherlands.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior Integration Software Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of software solutions used in real-world sensing and data processing systems. 

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who is passionate about quality, structured validation, and delivering robust software in complex engineering environments. 

As a Software Test Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and executing practical software tests to validate software components (including algorithms, cloud back-end, and user interfaces) that process sensor signals generated by fiber-optic sensing systems. You will work closely with data scientists, signal processing specialists, back-end developers, and software architects to ensure that products meet functional and non-functional requirements.

This role requires a hands-on professional with a proactive mindset, a structured approach to software testing, strong attention to detail, and the ability to understand complex technical systems and translate requirements into effective test strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 3 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer to develop and deploy machine learning solutions for real-world underwater acoustic sensing systems.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing cutting-edge fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments, including underwater acoustics, offshore energy, and defense applications. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with a Senior AI/ML Engineer who combines strong mathematical foundations with applied machine learning expertise to enhance the next generation of intelligent acoustic sensing solutions.

Role Overview:

As a Senior AI/ML Engineer, you will apply machine learning to real-world underwater acoustic sensing challenges using Optics11’s fiber-optic technology platforms. You will work closely with acoustics engineers, signal-processing specialists, and embedded/software teams to develop robust ML components that integrate seamlessly into operational systems.

This role requires a strong foundation in signal processing, applied mathematics, and statistics, and the ability to combine physics-based acoustic algorithms with data-driven ML methods.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement machine learning solutions for underwater acoustic sensing use cases, including detection, classification, localization and anomaly monitoring within fiber-optic sensing systems.

  • Select and adapt modelling approaches based on data availability, operational constraints and system requirements.

  • Apply strong foundations in applied mathematics, statistics and signal processing (e.g., beamforming, spectral analysis, detection pipelines) and integrate these with modern data-driven ML techniques.

  • Design, train, evaluate and benchmark AI/ML models, ensuring robustness, generalization and deployment readiness.

  • Validate models rigorously across laboratory experiments and offshore field datasets, with clear performance tracking and reproducible experimentation.

  • Analyze and interpret large-scale experimental and real-world fiber-optic sensing datasets, contributing to scalable workflows for data preparation, labelling and augmentation.

  • Support technical trade-offs between accuracy, interpretability, latency and real-time or embedded constraints.

  • Collaborate closely with acoustics engineers, signal processing specialists, software and embedded teams to integrate ML components into operational acoustic sensing pipelines.

  • Translate complex AI/ML results into clear technical insights that inform system-level engineering decisions.

  • Contribute to strong engineering practices, including version-controlled experiments, documentation, traceability, validation standards and continuous improvement of ML components.

  • Stay informed about advances in AI/ML for time-series analysis, sensor fusion and signal-informed learning, and prototype promising approaches that complement the broader technology stack.

What's in it for you? 

  • Competitive salary .

  • Innovative high-tech, international organization .

  • The opportunity to work in a cross-functional and interdisciplinary environment .

  • A lot to learn and to develop, we stimulate personal development .

  • Lunches.


Required Qualifications 

  • MSc in Machine Learning, Signal Processing, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, or a related field. 

  • Strong foundation in linear algebra, probability, statistics, and signal processing. 

  • Proven experience applying AI/ML methods to time-series or sensor data, including techniques such as: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) (e.g., LSTMs), Transformer-based architectures for time-series learning.

  • Supervised and unsupervised learning approaches for detection and classification.

  • Hands-on experience with model training, evaluation, and validation in applied settings.

  • Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX).

  • Ability to work in an applied R&D environment with experimental and field data, balancing model performance with real-world constraints.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with underwater acoustics, sonar, or beamforming-related applications.

  • Knowledge of embedded or real-time deployment constraints.

  • Experience with sensor fusion, self-supervised learning, or physics-informed ML.

  • Familiarity with offshore, defense, or industrial monitoring domains.

  • Familiarity with structured ML development processes such as CRISP-ML(Q) or similar lifecycle and quality frameworks.

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. Life at Plume

At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data. 

With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day.

Plume is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Customer Solutions Engineer to join our dynamic team. As a key technical advisor, you'll work directly with Internet Service Providers (ISPs), acting as the bridge between their business needs and our cutting-edge solutions. You'll play a crucial role in the sales process, from initial discovery to successful deployment, ensuring our partners achieve maximum value from our products.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a technically adept individual with a passion for networking, cloud, and AI who thrives in a customer-facing role.

Responsibilities
  • Technical Trusted Advisor: Engage with ISPs to deeply understand their technical and business requirements, and then effectively demonstrate how Plume's solutions can meet and exceed those needs.
  • Product Demos & Trials: Conduct compelling product demonstrations and manage complex proof-of-concept (PoC) and field trials, showcasing the tangible benefits of Plume's technology.
  • System Integration: Collaborate with our internal Customer Engineering, Product Management, and Operational teams to understand and deliver Plume's solutions within a customer's ecosystem. You'll work to integrate our solutions into their existing BSS/OSS, CRM, ticketing, and AI platforms using APIs and other integration methods.
  • Sales Enablement: Work closely with the sales organization to drive revenue, achieve sales quotas, and contribute to the overall growth of the business.
  • Presentations & Events: Prepare and deliver high-impact presentations, including Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and represent Plume at industry events and conferences.
  • Product Development Input: Provide valuable feedback to our product and engineering teams based on customer requirements and market trends, helping to inform the development of new features and solutions.
  • Technical Support: Offer prompt local and remote technical support for PoCs, lab trials, and deployment ramp-ups, ensuring a smooth and successful customer journey.
  • Industry Expertise: Continuously research and stay up-to-date on the latest industry standards and emerging technologies in networking, cloud architectures, and AI.
Experience & Qualifications
  • Hands-on Technical Experience: Strong hands-on experience in the configuration and deployment of software and hardware, including Wi-Fi, networking equipment, and cloud services. A fundamental understanding of cloud architectures and AI principles is essential. Deep understanding and knowledge of Residential and SMB Gateways is a big plus.
  • ISP SaaS Experience: Proven experience working with ISPs to deploy large-scale SaaS network solutions to millions of endpoints.
  • Communication & Collaboration: A track record of developing and maintaining professional, cooperative relationships with all levels of staff and customers.
  • Networking & Cloud Certifications: Relevant certifications such as CWNA, CCNA, or AWS Solutions Architect are highly preferred.
  • Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience: 5+ years of related experience working with network, security, SaaS, and/or AI industries.
  • Education: A BS/BA degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience.
  • Industry Knowledge: In-depth industry knowledge and a strong understanding of SDN and wireless technologies, solutions, and product offerings are preferred.
  • Communication Skills: Advanced written and oral communication skills.
  • Travel: Ability to travel >70% of the time.
Location/Language: This is a remote position. Candidates must be based in United Kingdom or Netherlands and be fluent in English.

About Plume

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM. 

Using OpenSync, the most widely supported open-source, silicon-to-cloud framework for smart spaces, Plume's software-defined network allows ISPs to decouple their service offerings from hardware and rapidly curate and deliver new services over a multi-vendor, open-platform architecture.

About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer, you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing.


What you'll be doing

  • Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines.

  • Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs.

  • Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints.

  • Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations.

  • Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust.


Your Profile

  • MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus).

  • Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship.

  • Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal).

  • Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis.

  • Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation.

  • Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team.

  • Familiarity with superconducting qubits, circuit quantisation, or cleanroom fabrication processes is a plus.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Creating content that resonates is great — turning that attention into growth is even better. That's what Manychat does.

We're 400+ people across three continents behind the leading platform for conversational growth, with AI skills shaping how we build, how we work, and how we grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR 🌟

Your decisions here won't get lost in a big system. They'll define it.

As Staff Backend Engineer for Manychat for Brands, you’ll own the technical side of a new product. You’ll set the architecture and technical priorities with the team, and decide what lives in our Python services and what stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. It’s an individual contributor role with a lot of room to make an impact.

The product fills a real gap. Brands pay influencers to post but then can’t see what happens next. We’re building the first view that shows it: who asked for the link, who opened the DM, who clicked, for every campaign, creator and post.

You’ll work with Product as a partner and stay close to brands and creators, so feedback reaches you fast and helps you shape Manychat for Brands.

Sound like you? Let’s talk!

YOUR FUTURE TEAMMATES 👋

Meet the Engineering team:

We keep Manychat running smoothly under high load every single day and make sure it's ready to scale even further. We do it by combining strong engineering foundations with AI tools that let us move faster without cutting corners. And we're the ones who shape and own what gets built. AI accelerates. Humans own the thinking.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🚀

  • Set the architecture and technical priorities for Brands together with the Engineering Manager and the team: service boundaries, data models, authentication, access control, and integration with the core Manychat platform.

  • Decide which logic belongs in the Python-based Brands services and which stays in the PHP-based Manychat platform. Think about data ownership, reliability, and long-term maintenance.

  • Lead big system-level changes when the path isn't clear yet. Explore options, split the work into measurable milestones, and plan data migrations, gradual rollouts, and rollbacks.

  • Define reliability and performance requirements for key Brands workflows. Set metrics and observability, and check the impact of your changes on production data.

  • Find the root causes of slowdowns and repeated incidents across service boundaries, using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.

  • Work with Security, Infrastructure, and Platform teams on solutions. Decide what to fix in the application and what needs other teams, and explain the trade-offs clearly.

  • Work with Product on the approach and scope of solutions, and suggest simpler options when you see them.

  • Make technical decisions easy to follow: document key choices and the reasons behind them, do thorough design and code reviews, and share your knowledge in complex areas.

  • A strong product mindset. You work closely with Product Managers, challenge assumptions, and explain technical trade-offs in terms of user experience, timelines, and product capabilities.

  • Experience owning the architecture and production operations of a product or a large technical area, not only delivering separate features.

  • A solid understanding of distributed systems and data flows: API contracts, async processing, data consistency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.

  • Knowledge of how backend applications are deployed and run in production: configuration, networking, and external dependencies.

  • Knowledge of application security basics: authentication, authorization, data isolation, and access management.

  • Comfort in a fast-changing environment. Things can shift quickly here, and the team relies on everyone's proactivity and ownership.

  • Strong English for technical and product discussions and for documentation.

  • Experience with ETL/DWH pipelines and analytics systems.

  • Experience with environment configuration, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code.

  • Experience improving AI-assisted software development practices.

Our tech stack: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Celery. Our services integrate with Manychat's PHP-based platform. Everything runs on AWS and Kubernetes, with Terraform/Terragrunt for infrastructure. You don't need hands-on experience with every tool. Technical depth and the ability to reason about complex systems matter most.

The short version

Plenty of companies are still running AI pilots. We moved past that a while ago: AI agents and human experts create, localise, check and refresh content for global B2B brands every day, across markets and languages. The next question is a harder one: not how to make content, but which content a client should make at all. That's where you come in.

As an AI Builder, you work on both sides of that. About half your time goes to bringing new clients live. The rest goes to building the intelligence that tells each client what to make next: where competitors outrank them, which pages are losing ground and need a refresh, which topics are an opening nobody has claimed yet, and whether they show up when people ask ChatGPT or Google instead of searching.

We've built our own CRM; our teams work with agents that do everything from setting up a tailor-made demo for a prospect to preparing sales calls and routing client feedback to the right person, and people across the company build their own tools. If you want to do serious work with AI, this is a good place for it. Everyone here is already building.

What Contentoo does

Most content tools make the client the editor. Most agencies make them the project manager. We'd rather make them the approver: they brief, review, and approve, and we run everything in between, inside their own workflow and tools. That makes us a product with a large service layer, sitting where SaaS, service and AI overlap.

None of that works without good foundations, so that's where we start. Before any agent runs, we capture what makes a client's content theirs: strategy, tone, terminology, compliance rules and hero pieces, per language and market, confirmed by the client. Every agent, expert and signal draws on that brand context. Skip it, and you get generic content, faster.

There's no shortage of software that tells a client what to write. The difference is that we get those foundations right first and then actually do the work. We've been doing that for ten years: 300+ brands, 300,000+ completed projects and 49 languages.

What you'll do

A suite of Workflows already runs in production, from localisation and creation to brand checks and content refresh. Each one combines AI agents with human experts and works from the client's brand context.

In practice, your week splits two ways. Half of it is implementation: getting new clients live, finding out where their situation is different from the last client's, and building the fix quickly, whether that's a new skill for their agent, a connection to their CMS, or a check only their market needs. Then you make that whole process faster and more automated on our side, so the next client goes live with less hand work.

The other half is the layer on top, which we're building right now: brand intelligence. Today most marketing teams guess what to write next. We want every client to know. Their own search data shows which pages are slipping, and a page that slips already gets a one-click refresh. Competitor rankings show where others win the topics the client should own. Strategy gets drafted from search data in each market and confirmed by the client, so every piece has a reason to exist. And every week we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI to answer the questions their buyers ask, to see whether the client is named or a competitor is. Every expert fix and every client comment flows back into the brand context, so the platform gets better with each piece.

What works for one client becomes a feature for all of them. And our own teams are clients too. Sales asks the CRM and the agents for a prospect's history before a call. Anyone in the company can ask Conny, our assistant on top of KIWI, our company knowledge base, how billing works or what a package includes. Product feedback from clients gets sorted and routed to the right owner by an agent. When one of those tools needs to get better, you build that too, with Claude Code, the Claude and GPT APIs, MCP servers and agent skills: whatever does the job.

The team

You join the Product team under Olivier (CPO) and report to Joost (AI Lead), in our growing AI team. You'll work closely with Jorge (Product Lead), Cesar (Tech Lead) and our development hub in Valencia.

Around you are the Connies: our people in Amsterdam and in our growing Valencia office. Once a month we stop for Success & Drinks, a company update with no slides and lots of energy, where anyone can take the floor to show what they've built. Wins get celebrated in #shoutout, from a sales call that nailed it to the talent team finding the right experts for a client's healthcare content. We play a padel tournament every year, run the city business run together (the ones who don't run come for the drinks afterwards), and take honest feedback seriously enough to train for it.

Who you are

You're a builder who gets energy from seeing a client actually use what you made. Three things come together in you:

Judgement. You quickly see what's really going on with a client, and you're as credible talking ROI with a CFO as architecture with an engineer.

You build. You prototype fast and ship, and you're at home with LLM APIs, agents, MCP, skills, and tools like Claude Code. You've built AI tools that real people use, and you can tell us what happened after launch.

Hands in the mud. You love being close to clients: fixing what gets in their way, building what solves their next problem, and owning what you ship. Under the hood, it has to work, stay up, and be safe. Your best hours go to the client.

You might come from strategy, product, solutions engineering, or technical implementation. Or you became the AI person at your last company and want a lot more of it.

Fluent English is a must; Dutch is a plus. We are looking for someone available 32-40h per week.

If seeing a client use something you built last week excites you more than perfecting the architecture behind it, you'll love it here. You'd be building on a business that's doing very well, with a large network of expert freelancers behind it: clients, data, and experts from day one, and an operation that keeps running while we scale. If you'd rather start from a blank page, a startup will suit you better. But if you want to make AI fly at scale, this is the place.

What you’ll get

  • A competitive salary based on experience

  • 25 vacation days per year

  • Pension contribution

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens, 2-3 days in office, plus remote flexibility)

  • A small AI team with a mandate to grow: real leadership opportunities, an L&D budget and direct exposure to the MT and founders

  • Laptop of choice (Mac or HP)

  • A monthly Alleo budget

  • A learning budget

  • Lunch and a bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

  • A fun, inclusive team, regular company events, boat days, and more

Why Contentoo, why now

  • You'll build things people keep using. In client conversations, in the code and in the product, every week.

  • The foundations are already there. 300+ clients, real integrations, structured brand context, Workflows in production, and real budget committed to AI. You build on top, not from zero.

  • The market is wide open. Most enterprises are stuck somewhere between "we bought ChatGPT licences" and "our content still isn't better". We're building the bridge, and there's no playbook for it yet.

  • What you build compounds. A win for one client becomes a feature for all of them.

Sounds interesting?

Let’s have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)

We're partnering with a defence technology company developing and mass-producing autonomous systems for real-world deployment.
This is a full-cycle hardware business where R&D, engineering, manufacturing and field operations sit close together, and where products evolve continuously based on direct operational feedback.
The company is already operating at meaningful scale, with a growing ecosystem spanning UAVs, unmanned ground systems and communication technologies. As the product line expands, they're strengthening the hardware team. We're looking for a Hardware Electronics Engineer to join this team.

The Role:
You'll design electronics for UAV components, primarily flight controllers and ESCs, and own the full hardware cycle from schematic to production-ready PCB. You'll take boards through layout, manufacturing outputs, DFM with fabs and assembly houses, and into the lab for bring-up and debugging, with your designs going into products that are built at volume and used in the field.
For an engineer with a background in power electronics or motor control, this is an opportunity to work on compact, high-current boards where design decisions have direct, visible impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Design schematics for flight controllers, ESCs and related UAV electronics: component selection, power stages, MCU circuits, sensors and interfaces

  • Create multilayer PCB layouts in Altium, including high-current power routing, thermal management and signal integrity

  • Prepare manufacturing outputs: Gerbers, BOM, pick-and-place, assembly drawings

  • Support the DFM/DFA phase together with PCB fabs and assembly houses

  • Bring up and debug prototypes, and fix issues found in testing

  • Take part in peer design reviews, both giving and receiving feedback

  • Maintain design documentation and component libraries

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of hands-on hardware design experience (schematic and PCB layout)

  • Strong working knowledge of Altium Designer

  • Experience with multilayer PCBs and power electronics: DC-DC converters, MOSFET stages, current sensing

  • Experience with microcontroller-based designs (e.g. STM32) and common interfaces: SPI, I2C, UART, CAN

  • Practical understanding of DFM/DFA and work with PCB manufacturers

  • Lab skills: oscilloscope, power supply, multimeter, soldering and rework

  • Technical English sufficient to read datasheets and write documentation

Would be a plus: direct experience with drone flight controllers or ESCs (BLDC motor drives, FOC); familiarity with ArduPilot, PX4 or Betaflight hardware ecosystems; EMC/EMI-aware design for compact, high-current boards; design for harsh environments (vibration, temperature); basic Python for test automation.

Hi! 👋 I'm Sam, Engineering Manager for Team Booking Management at WeTravel.

I joined WeTravel to help simplify how group travel businesses handle payments and bookings. Our Booking Management team owns the journey from the moment a traveler decides to book: checkout flows, order management, tax management, and everything that enables travelers to easily make a reservation and manage it afterwards. Last year alone, over a million travelers booked adventures through our platform! As we streamline and localize our booking experience, I'm looking for engineers who are excited about making complex booking and commerce flows feel simple for our global users.

About WeTravel:

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform makes it simple for organizers to create beautiful trip proposals, securely process payments, and manage their customers, so they can focus on what they do best: creating amazing experiences.

This is one of the last great frontiers of travel to come online, and as the category leader, we are at the forefront of this change. Last year alone, our platform was trusted by 8,000 organizers to lead over a million travelers on adventures in 150+ countries. Now, we're on an exciting journey to grow from powering $1B to $10B in travel experiences per year.

We believe that every trip, when done right, can be a force for good - and we're building the engine to make more of that possible.

What's the role:

You will join the Booking Management team to lead critical projects across checkout, order management, tax management, and traveler self-service. Upcoming work includes:

  • Checkout experience: streamlining and localizing our checkout flows so travelers in every market can complete a reservation in just a few clicks.

  • Order management: building the foundational systems for organizers and travelers to view, modify, and manage reservations end-to-end - changes, transfers, cancellations, and everything in between.

  • Tax management: expanding our tax capabilities across jurisdictions so organizers can sell compliantly wherever their travelers are.

  • Reliability and structural improvements: scaling our booking flows to support 10x growth.

What you'll do day-to-day:

Behind every unforgettable trip is a travel business that needs its tools to just work. Our Solution Engineering team makes that possible: we connect WeTravel to the way organizers already run their business, so growing from ten trips to a thousand never means drowning in manual work.

As a Senior Solution Engineer, your role spans both pre- and post-sale: from technical evaluation and solution design with high-value prospects, to driving adoption and long-term implementation with existing customers. Every integration you deliver will teach us what to build next, and you’ll turn those lessons into better public interfaces for all our organizers!

About WeTravel

Think of the most incredible adventures imaginable: trekking to Machu Picchu, cycling through Tuscany, or going on a safari in Kenya. For years, the small businesses and local experts who run these trips have been stuck using messy spreadsheets, countless emails, and complicated payment methods.

WeTravel is changing that. We build the tools that empower any entrepreneur to launch and grow their own travel business. Our platform takes care of the business behind the trip: proposals, bookings, payments and customer management. That lets organizers focus on what they do best: designing and leading unforgettable experiences.

What's the role

As organizers grow, WeTravel stops being a standalone tool and becomes part of their stack. A tour operator wants bookings to flow into their own tools, payments to land in their accounting system, and leads to sync with their CRM. Getting that right is often what wins the deal, and what keeps the customer for years.

In practice, you're the technical partner organizers and our commercial team rely on, from the first discovery call to a smooth go-live. You'll understand how a travel business runs, design how WeTravel fits into it, and prove it works using our public APIs, webhooks and no-code tools like Zapier.

But the role goes beyond individual customers. As more organizers connect WeTravel to their business, every integration teaches us something about what the platform should do next. We want Solution Engineering to be the voice of our customers' integration needs inside engineering, and a stakeholder for WeTravel's public interfaces. You'll spot the patterns across deals, decide what should become a platform capability instead of a one-off, and work with product engineering teams to make it happen. A few areas where we'll need you:

  • Public API and webhooks: bring input in the roadmap of our APIs based on what customers actually try to build

  • Integration playbooks: turn recurring setups into reusable guides, templates and reference implementations

  • Pre-sales at scale: create demos, sample and solution blueprints that help our sales team answer technical questions confidently, without needing an engineer on every call

Our success here will make WeTravel easy to adopt for larger and more complex organizers, and will let our team support many more customers without growing linearly.

What you'll do day-to-day

Your time will be split roughly evenly between helping us win deals and helping customers succeed after they sign.

Pre-sales

  • Join Account Executives on discovery and demo calls, uncover the prospect's technical requirements, and map their workflows to WeTravel

  • Scope integrations and migrations, answer security and technical questionnaires, and give honest answers on what's possible today and what isn't

  • Build tailored demos and quick proofs of concept that show how WeTravel plugs into the prospect's existing tools

Implementation and support

  • Guide customers and their developers through integrations with Google Analytics, Zapier, QuickBooks, our public APIs and webhooks, as well as data migrations, complex inventory setups and go-live

  • Troubleshoot complex integration issues with customers, and make sure what you learn flows back into our docs, playbooks and product

  • Write scripts, prototypes and sample apps (Python, JavaScript, Postman collections, Zapier flows) that unblock customers and can be reused by others

Shaping the platform

  • Represent customer integration needs in product and engineering planning, backed by data from deals and tickets

  • Build and maintain our integration documentation, playbooks and internal knowledge base

  • Use AI tools to automate the repetitive parts of the job, from ticket triage to generating integration code

What success looks like

  • First month: you know our product, APIs and the most common integration setups. You've shadowed sales calls and resolved your first technical tickets end-to-end.

  • First three months: you run technical discovery and demos on your own, own customer implementations through go-live, and have shipped reusable assets .

  • First six months: you own a clear picture of what our customers try to build with WeTravel, and bring data-backed proposals into engineering planning. Your playbooks and tools mean the team takes on more customers with less custom work.

How we work

  • You'll be part of the Solutions Engineering team within our Engineering organisation.

  • You'll work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Account Management, Product and Engineering, and have a seat at the table in deal reviews.

  • We're focused on impact. We move quickly, value clarity, and adapt our processes based on what works.

  • We'd rather build something once and automated than solve it ten times by hand.

  • We use the latest hardware and are constantly on the lookout for better tools and ways to work, including AI assistants and agents.

  • Our tools: REST APIs, Postman, Zapier, HubSpot, Snowflake. Our platform runs on React/TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Python and Go microservices on Kubernetes.

You should apply if you have

Basic qualifications

  • A track record of 7+ years in a customer-facing technical role (Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Integration Engineer or similar)

  • Hands-on fluency with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and authentication (API keys, OAuth). You can read API docs, debug a failing request and explain why it failed

  • Familiarity with integration tools like Zapier: you can design, troubleshoot and optimise automated workflows

  • Comfort writing scripts and prototypes in at least one language (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Ruby or Go)

  • Experience leading technical discovery and demos with prospects, and owning implementations through go-live

  • The ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical people, and to translate customer needs into clear requirements for engineers

  • Good judgment about when to solve a problem for one customer and when to push for a platform solution

  • Excellent communication skills in English and experience working in multicultural, distributed teams

  • Experience using AI assistants like Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT to speed up your work

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in travel, tourism or booking platforms, including inventory and availability setups

  • Knowledge of payments, accounting, analytics or CRM integrations (e.g. QuickBooks, Xero, Google Analytics, HubSpot, Salesforce)

  • Experience influencing API design or a developer platform roadmap

  • Don’t tick every box? If the role excites you and you’ve got most of what we’re looking for, we’d still love to hear from you

Why join us?

  • Make a real impact: you'll help build the operating system for the multi-day group travel industry, empowering thousands of organizers and millions of travelers worldwide.

  • Shape the platform, not just tickets: your insights from customers will directly impact what our engineering teams build.

  • Work at the intersection of tech and business: you'll partner with Sales, Customer Success and Engineering every week, and see the direct impact of your work on deals won and customers launched.

  • Help build the team: you'll join a small team at an inflection point, with real ownership over how Solutions Engineering works at WeTravel.


    Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Generous "Time to Recharge" policy - enjoy unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, and show up as your best self.

  • Work remotely for a maximum of 4 weeks per calendar year.

  • 2-week cross-functional onboarding program.

  • Beautiful office in central Amsterdam – rooftop garden and right by Rokin metro.

  • Access to a 10% group discount on supplementary/additional health insurance (aanvullende verzekeringen), with the same discount available to eligible family members.

  • Join an international, travel-loving team with a passion for adventure and innovation

Ready to build something meaningful? Apply now.

Equal Opportunities

Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis.


The Role:
Do you enjoy turning complex data into strategic insights that drive critical decisions? As a Senior China Research Analyst, you will lead analytical research projects for our government clients. You'll turn their most pressing questions about China's technology, industrial, and defence-industrial landscape into data-driven reports and the datasets behind them. You'll work with Datenna's data on patents, procurement, research funding, and companies, and go beyond it when a question demands, to find the patterns and connections that inform high-stakes policy and security decisions. 


You'll independently manage several client research projects at a time, from scoping through final delivery, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis across China's corporate, academic, defence, and technology sectors. Client questions often start ambiguous and open-ended, and topics range widely, from advanced materials to semiconductors and aerospace. You'll work through uncertainty, get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technologies, design creative analytical approaches when the path isn't obvious, and refine your research direction as new information emerges. The role needs strong China expertise, Chinese-language research skills, the ability to work autonomously, and clear communication with senior government stakeholders. 

 

Your mission at Datenna:

  • Lead end-to-end research delivery: Take full ownership of research projects, from initial scoping and analysis through to final deliverables. 

  • Design the research: Turn open-ended client questions into sound research design, and build new analytical frameworks when standard methods don't fit. 

  • Build and analyse the evidence base: Work directly with Chinese-language sources and Datenna's data on entities, patents, procurement, and research funding to map the actors, links, and trends that answer the client's question. 

  • Set the quality bar: Review colleagues' deliverables independently, verify findings against the underlying data, and guide Analysts on their research approach. 

  • Work with AI, with judgement: Use AI-assisted research tools to work faster and at greater scale. You own the interpretation and verify every output. 

  • Contribute to the China Research Lab: The Lab is our exploratory research track. It develops the methods, tools, and data sources that shape where China research at Datenna is heading, and tests them through internal R&D. You will dedicate part of your time to Lab initiatives, such as prototyping a new analytical approach, scouting and testing new sources, or contributing to webinars and publications. 

  • Strengthen the data and product: Turn what you learn on client projects into data and product improvements, working with the Product and Data teams. 


What makes you a great candidate:
Core requirements 

  • Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in China-focused research, analysis, or related fields. 

  • Deep China expertise: Strong knowledge of Chinese industry, economy, policy, the defence-industrial base, and the technology and research landscape. 

  • Analytical excellence: Exceptional pattern recognition and analytical skills to connect the dots between corporate, state, and military actors in China's techno-economic landscape. 

  • Comfort with ambiguity: Proven ability to tackle research questions where the analytical path isn't predetermined, designing creative approaches and adapting as you learn. 

  • Chinese language proficiency: Professional reading proficiency in Chinese (minimum HSK5, HSK6 preferred) to work directly with Chinese-language sources such as technical literature, patents, procurement notices, and policy documents, and to build and verify Chinese technical terminology for data retrieval. 

  • Self-directed project management: Proven ability to independently break down complex research questions, run several multi-week projects in parallel against fixed client deadlines, and deliver high-quality output with minimal oversight. 

  • Quality ownership: An evidence-first approach. You trace every claim back to its source records, catch inconsistencies in data and drafts, and review others' work independently and constructively. 

  • Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication, including precise, concise English writing for an international readership. You are comfortable presenting complex analysis to senior government stakeholders and refining requirements through client dialogue. 

  • Methodological versatility: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods. 


Technical skills 

  • Working proficiency in SQL and/or Python to query, clean, and structure large datasets, plus advanced Excel. 

  • Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in research, with a clear sense of where their output needs human verification. 

  • Familiarity with data-quality work such as deduplication and entity resolution. 


Nice to have 

  • Experience in the technology, science, and research sector within governmental organisations, think tanks, or international corporate settings. 

  • Background conducting research for external clients or stakeholders. 

  • Experience analysing patents, public procurement, research funding, or corporate registry data. 

  • Experience collecting web data from Chinese-language sources, or with BI tools such as Metabase. 

  • A technical or scientific background (for example materials science, engineering, or physics) relevant to dual-use technology topics. 

*Please know that applicants may be subject to a screening process.*


  • Work on globally impactful projects in geopolitical intelligence

  • Lead innovation in OSINT and AI technologies

  • Dynamic, international team environment

  • Significant growth opportunities in a scale-up

Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.

What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure:

  • Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

  • Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

  • Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

  • Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

  • Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

Deployment & Serving:

  • Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

  • Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions

ML Acceleration:

  • Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

  • Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile

  • Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts

  • Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

  • Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices:

  • Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

  • Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

  • Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

  • Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

  • Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

  • Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

  • Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

  • Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

  • Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

  • Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

  • Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

  • Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

  • State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

  • Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

  • Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

  • Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

  • Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

  • Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

data.description:
Lightspeed is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

As a Field Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Lightspeed brand in your area. 

Your responsibilities:

  • Generate lists of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial outbound call/ walk in to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus)

  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 

  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery

  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities

  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Lightspeed in the market

What you will bring to the team: 

  • Dutch fluency is a must 

  • Experience in a sourcing or closing customers, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry

  • Since this is a field position, you will be out and about on a daily basis in your territory 

  • Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels

  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment

  • Self-motivated, creative, and flexible

  • General technical proficiency with software

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM is a plus

What’s in it for you?

Come Live the Lightspeed Experience….

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding.

  • Uncapped commission

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact;

and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health 

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform 

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

  • LinkedIn Learning: At Lightspeed we believe in having a growth mindset, we provide free access to LinkedIn learning along with your career GPS to help you learn & grow

  • Subsidy to annual travel pass if you travel by public transport to the office 

  • Regular breakfast or lunches, drinks & snacks in our Amsterdam office 

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.
